rationale: Prospective promotion-eligible internal replication of the bounded Temporal-Order Stage-1 claim. It preserves the six-neuron dual-channel task, intact and identity-destroyed arms, simultaneous control, frozen decoder and single paired inferential contrast from V2, while using fresh predeclared seeds and the current EvidenceEngine provenance contract. Historical V2 artifacts remain immutable.

task.decoder: forward if first output_A spike precedes first output_B spike; reverse if B precedes A; simultaneous if their first output spikes occur on the same tick

arms.intact: logical A/B event identity is preserved at the two physical input channels
arms.identity_destroyed: both logical A/B events are injected into physical input_A; event count, event times, per-event current and total injected charge are preserved, but channel identity is deliberately removed

seed_bound_nuisance_realizations.purpose: prospective paired robustness realizations; not independent external replication
seed_bound_nuisance_realizations.matching_rule: for a given seed, the same sampled weight and current are used for all arms and orders
seed_bound_nuisance_realizations.forbidden_use: parameters may not be selected from observed task outcomes

evaluation.freshness_rule: All promotion seeds were checked against repository text before freeze and are disjoint from the historical TEMP-002 V1 seeds 101-120, Temporal-Order V2 seeds 7101-7120, Stage-1 topology V2 seeds 2101-2120, topology V3 seeds 6101-6120, topology V3-R1 seeds 6201-6220 and topology promotion seeds 6301-6320.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: per-seed balanced order-decoding accuracy across forward and reverse trials
evaluation.primary_contrast: intact minus identity_destroyed, paired by seed

analysis.test: exact two-sided paired sign test on per-seed intact-minus-identity-destroyed accuracy deltas
analysis.effect_interval: deterministic paired bootstrap 95% CI for median accuracy delta, 5000 resamples
analysis.multiple_testing: not applicable; exactly one primary inferential contrast

decision_rule.supported_within_protocol: all four directional/task gates pass, paired sign-test p < alpha, bootstrap CI excludes zero, and all design-integrity checks pass
decision_rule.no_predefined_support: one or more preregistered task/inference gates fail despite intact design integrity

integrity_constraints: exactly six runs per seed: two arms x three orders
six neurons and four synapses in every run
identical sampled weight/current across all six runs of a seed
identical event count and total injected charge across arms
claim_boundary: This prospective promotion replication tests only CLAIM-S1-TEMP-001 / RQ-TEMP-002 / H-TEMP-002-A in the registered six-neuron acyclic two-channel Small-SNN task. It asks whether preserved A/B channel identity supports fixed temporal-order decoding while the identity-destroyed matched control removes that signal. A successful run creates promotion-eligible DATA only; EVID still requires a separate canonical human review and explicit EvidenceEngine promotion. It does not establish learning, memory, cognition, biological equivalence, scaling, 5D superiority, general temporal reasoning or independent external replication.
